tool.name: AI 最后一公里 · 提词器
tool.nameEn: The Last Mile of AI · Teleprompter
tool.description: 专为峰会演讲设计的网页提词器，支持中英双语对照、语速调节、镜像显示及生词标注。帮助演讲者在演示过程中精准把控节奏、查看提示信息并流畅完成演讲。
tool.descriptionEn: A web-based teleprompter designed for summit speeches, featuring bilingual support, adjustable speech rates, mirror mode, and vocabulary annotations. It helps speakers manage their pace, view cues, and deliver presentations smoothly.
